description: Thresholds for the Accountable DVN attestation gate. Parameter names match Tempora's own published aCV mandate vocabulary (proof_max_age_seconds, min_verifiability_rung, max_nav_deviation_pct) one-to-one.

proof_max_age_seconds.description: Maximum allowed age, in seconds, of Accountable's snapshot for the venue under consideration. A proof older than this denies.

min_verifiability_rung.description: Floor on Accountable's ordinal verifiability rating for the venue (their published scale, currently 1-6). A proof weaker than this denies.

max_nav_deviation_pct.description: Maximum allowed divergence, as a percentage, between Accountable's attested value and the on-chain price read at evaluation time. A wider divergence denies.

deny_on_carry_forward_proof.description: Deny when Accountable flags the snapshot as a carried-forward (reused prior) value rather than a fresh proof, even if it is still within proof_max_age_seconds.

require_roster_membership.description: Deny when the venue is absent from Accountable's covered-venue roster.

min_success_ratio.description: Circuit breaker on Accountable's network-wide success_count/total_count. Denies when the ratio drops below this floor, e.g. during a provider-side degradation.
